markdown.markdown:
```{=html}
GLOBAL EDUCATION PARTNERSHIPS

We are seeking educational institutions and partners
to research and practice PLUSZONE Education together

1Teacher Training
2Joint Development of Educational Content
3Global Educational Cooperation
PLUSZONE BEGAN IN EDUCATIONAL SETTINGS

Turning Field Experience into Educational Trust

PLUSZONE Education has developed through the two educators’ many years of teaching experience and real interactions with students. They have explored educational methods that help students reflect, judge, and act independently.

STUDENT STORIES

Student Transformation: Discover Real-Life Case Studies

We provide materials presenting real classroom cases in which students reflect on their thoughts and actions and put better choices into practice.

See cases of student change
EDUCATION KOREA 2027
EXHIBITION PARTICIPATION

We will be exhibiting at EDUCATION KOREA 2027

The 24th Korea Education Expo
DATE
Jan. 27 (Wed) – 29 (Fri), 2027
VENUE
COEX Halls A & B, Seoul
Interested in working together?Find training and partnership enquiries on our contact page.
Contact us →
```
